source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: A simple pencil drawing will be enough to communicate the general idea, so please do not spend too much time on the first draft. Could you indicate the positions of the 3 new bathrooms, the 3 new kitchen cabinets, and the separation walls, including how you would divide the houses?

value_updates.kitchen_cabinet_layout: Indicate the position of the new kitchen cabinet for Unit 3 in the subdivision concept.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: All right, please proceed with developing the details for the kitchen cabinets.

value_updates.cabinet_design_detail_level: Develop the kitchen-cabinet details beyond the initial concept sketch.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Mutfakları ayrı odalar yapmak yerine doğrudan açık salon konseptine dahil edelim ve mevcut duvarları olabildiğince aynı tutalım. Her ev için 240cm uzunluğunda hem üst hem de alt dolap yeterlidir.

value_updates.kitchen_concept: Open-concept kitchen integrated directly into the living room rather than enclosed in a separate room.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Mutfak tezgahı için bu alternatif yerleşimi 3 nolu 1+1 evde de kullanabiliriz. Bana daha iyi görünüyor, ancak bu düzen tezgahı banyo kapısına çok yaklaştırıyor.

value_updates.counter_placement_preference: Use the shown alternative counter placement for Unit 3 if adequate clearance from the bathroom door can be maintained.
value_updates.bathroom_door_clearance_constraint: The kitchen counter must not be positioned too close to the bathroom door.
